_provenance.sigver_derivation: sigVer entries below are NOT drawn from NIST's separate SLH-DSA-sigVer-FIPS205 test set. Each is the corresponding sigGen entry's own (pk, message, context, signature) — a genuine NIST-generated signature that must verify by construction. This was a deliberate choice to avoid a second ~30MB+70MB download for this pass; every byte is still 100% NIST-sourced, only the ACVP *operation* label differs from what a sigVer-set-sourced entry would say. A dedicated SLH-DSA-sigVer-FIPS205 pull (which also carries deliberately-invalid testPassed=false cases, useful adversarial coverage) remains a worthwhile follow-up, not done here.
_provenance.note: Replaces a prior file covering only SLH-DSA-SHA2-128f (1 of 12 parameter sets), itself untraceable to any real NIST sample case (2026-08-24 WS-6 remediation, H-4 — the plan's 'sharpest case': 11 of 12 parameter sets previously had no external vector at all, only self-consistency round-trips in HsmAcvpTesting.tsx section 9). Now covers all 12. WS-3.3 follow-up (2026-08-30): added preHashSigGen — genuine deterministic sk-based sigGen evidence for HashSLH-DSA pre-hash mode (FIPS 205 §10.1), from the same SLH-DSA-sigGen-FIPS205 source (source_sha256 re-verified unchanged) this file already used for context-mode sigGen/sigVer. 7 of the 12 deterministic preHash groups kept (tgId 6/10/12/20/22/24/28, one per parameter set, spanning SHA3-384/SHA3-224/SHA2-512/SHA2-224/SHAKE-256); the other 5 (tgId 2/4/8/26/30) use SHA-512/224 or SHA-512/256, which this engine does not implement (WS-6.3) — excluded and recorded here, not silently dropped. Root cause of the pre-hash mode itself (both ML-DSA and SLH-DSA wrapped the FIPS 204/205 hash OID in an X.509 AlgorithmIdentifier SEQUENCE instead of the raw OID both specs call for) fixed in OSSLSLHDSA.cpp the same day; each case here verifies that fix on the sign path independently of ML-DSA’s.
